target: methods/e02_friction_limit.py:71 and :76 (P_i = max(-sigma_n, 0) * A; N = P.sum()) = the mu_req 'calculation first' shortcut the PI made the deciding slip-out number on 2026-10-27 (docs/DECISIONS.md:93-98); same bias in the M2 force ratio (h15 Q47)
claim: The tied (glued) interface carries large TENSION that a real cage-bone interface cannot carry, and e02 turns it into friction capacity. At the peak of every physio window, 38-47 % of the glued face area is in tension (flexion / extension / lateral bending). e02 drops the tensile elements' normal force (sets P_i = 0) but keeps the compressive ones in full, so the compression it uses is N+ = N_net + T, where T (the glue's total tension) is 0.4 to 1.8 times the net compressive force N_net that actually presses the face. Without adhesion the total compression on a face is at most N_net, so mu_req is under-estimated by the factor N+/N_net = 1.4 to 2.8. Worst case, p062 extension, bottom face: e02 gives mu_req 0.119; with the net compression it is 0.328, and 0.468 when the out-of-plane shear is also kept (F-0011). At the PI's main mu 0.3 this flips p062 extension from 'holds' to 'does not hold'. Lateral bending, bottom face: M3 0.611 -> 1.082 (above even the 0.45 sensitivity value). Because the error grows with how much the glue pulls, it rewards designs whose tied model develops a lot of glue tension (stiff cages that bend, lever-like shapes). A designer optimising mu_req would be pushed toward exactly the designs a real interface cannot hold.

Code: e02_friction_limit.py:71 'a['P'].append(max(-sn, 0.0) * A); a['f'].append(tau[:2] * A)' (tension elements: P set to 0 but their shear kept in F and Mz); :76 'N = P.sum()' and mu_force = |F| / N. The docstring (:6-7) says P_i is 0 where the glue is in tension but does not say that N then exceeds the real compression. Physics: with no adhesion the normal tractions are all compressive and sum to the net normal force on the face, so sum(P_i) = N_net, not N+ (equilibrium of the face; only the distribution and the shear can change when the face opens). The 'M3 net' column scales P_i by N_net / N+ (same pattern), which is a crude correction, not a contact solution; the 'M2 net' column is exact for the given shear force.
how_to_reproduce: cd biocage-evo; python -I work/agents/redteam/r0003_tension.py p062_gpu2 p063_gpu3 p014_gpu1 (about 1 min; reads the old repo's physio_fix xplt files; writes r0003_tension_result.json). Compare columns M2e02 / M2net and M3e02 / M3net. Independent check: sum the signed normal force of the cage top-layer elements in any tied run; it is ~100-140 N, while the sum of the compressive parts alone is ~190-250 N.

fix_options.option: Use a frictional (unilateral, non-adhesive, mu = large or 'rough' no-slip once in contact) contact instead of tied glue for the mu_req run: the interface can open but not slide, so the pressures are real and the shear field is the stick field. mu_req = e02 limit on that run.
fix_options.cost: medium: one contact type change in the GPU solver (sliding with very high mu / sticky contact), needs its own gate
fix_options.risk: contact non-linearity returns (but no sliding, so stick-slip stalls are avoided)

fix_options.option: Keep tied, but report and use mu_req with N_net (scale P_i by N_net / N+ or solve the LP with the constraint sum P_i = N_net), plus the tension fraction T / N_net as a validity flag (e.g. tied result invalid for ranking when T / N_net > 0.1).
fix_options.risk: still approximate: the real pressure pattern after lift-off differs from the scaled tied pattern; only the force-ratio part is exact

fix_options.option: Freeze any ranking / promotion by mu_req (and the AL force-ratio objective) until option 1 or 2 is done and checked against a few full frictional runs (gate).

summary_zh: 最嚴重的問題：目前用來判斷 cage 會不會滑出的「計算優先」捷徑（摩擦需求值，程式 e02）系統性地低估了所需的摩擦。原因是模擬時把 cage 和骨頭「黏死」，黏膠在大約四成的接觸面上是在「拉」骨頭；真實的 cage 和骨頭之間沒有黏性，不能拉。程式把被拉的部分壓力設成零，卻保留另一側被擠壓的全部壓力，等於把黏膠的拉力當成可以產生摩擦的壓力。三個重跑案例中，被誤算進去的拉力是真實淨壓力的 0.4 到 1.8 倍，所以摩擦需求被低估 1.4 到 2.8 倍。例如 p062 後伸時下表面：程式算出需要 0.119，改用真實淨壓力是 0.328，再加上曲面的剪力是 0.468；在主設定摩擦係數 0.3 下，結論就由「不會滑」變成「會滑」。側彎時下表面由 0.611 變成 1.082。這個誤差會獎勵在黏死模型中拉力大的設計，設計者若用這個數字優化，會被引向真實介面最抓不住的形狀。建議：改用「可分開但不可滑動」的接觸計算摩擦需求，或至少改用淨壓力並標示拉力比例；修正前不要用這個數字排名設計。
